sourceMethod: All 100 main code rows were read from the supplied page-bounded primary OEM extracts. Referenced continuation pages were checked in the full local OEM texts; P006E p1054 was also visually inspected in the primary PDF. Only verified supported monitor claims are included; unresolved source wording or units are explicit and flagged. Prose was individually authored, including independent diagnostic implications; common cylinder families retain their genuinely shared OEM algorithm without inventing cylinder-specific causes.
